title: Harrow Emergency Help Points
summary: Offline guide to emergency medical help points, urgent care, and local hazards in the London Borough of Harrow.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 first (or 112). Call 105 for power cuts and 0800 111 999 for gas leaks.

1. 24-Hour Emergency Hospitals
- Northwick Park Hospital (24/7 A&E and Major Trauma Unit): Watford Road, Harrow, HA1 3UJ. From Harrow-on-the-Hill station: ~20 min walk northeast along Lowlands Road and Watford Road, or bus 182 or 186 directly to hospital grounds. From Northwick Park tube station: ~3 min walk across the footbridge directly into hospital grounds.
- St Mary's Hospital (Nearest Major Trauma Centre for central/west): Praed Street, Paddington, W2 1NY. Take Metropolitan line south to Baker Street, then Bakerloo line to Paddington.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres
- Northwick Park Urgent Treatment Centre: Located at the front of Northwick Park Hospital, Watford Road, HA1 3UJ. Co-located with A&E for non-life-threatening urgent injuries and illnesses.
- Pinn Medical Centre Walk-in Clinic: 37 Love Lane, Pinner, HA5 3EE. From Pinner station: ~3 min walk east via Love Lane.

3. Local Environmental Hazards
- Wealdstone Brook: High risk of surface-water and flash flooding along low-lying corridors through Harrow Weald, Wealdstone, and Kenton.
- River Pinn: Flood risk along green belt corridors through Pinner, Hatch End, and Eastcote borders during sustained heavy rainfall.

4. Essential Supplies
- Large supermarkets and retail pharmacies along St Anns Road (Harrow Town Centre), High Street Wealdstone, and Uxbridge Road in Stanmore supply bottled water, first-aid kits, and over-the-counter medicines during local outages.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
